description: This file implements a PermissionManager that handles various system permissions on macOS, such as location, notifications, camera, microphone, speech recognition, and screen recording. It includes methods to check permission statuses, request permissions interactively, and open system settings when necessary. The code also defines helper classes and enums for managing specific permissions and monitoring permission status changes.

classes.name: LocationPermissionRequester
classes.description: A singleton class handling location permission requests, utilizing CLLocationManager delegate callbacks and continuations to asynchronously obtain authorization status.

classes.name: PermissionMonitor
classes.description: An observable singleton class that periodically checks and monitors the status of various permissions, allowing components to register for updates.

methods.name: isLocationAuthorized
methods.description: Determines if the given location authorization status is considered authorized, optionally requiring 'always' authorization.

methods.name: ensure
methods.description: Requests and verifies multiple capabilities asynchronously, returning a dictionary of capability to boolean indicating success.

methods.name: ensureCapability
methods.description: Checks and requests a specific capability asynchronously, depending on the capability type.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current status of various permissions as a dictionary of capability to boolean.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks whether AppleScript automation permission is granted.

methods.name: requestAuthorization
methods.description: Triggers a prompt to request AppleScript automation permission and opens system preferences if needed.

methods.name: refreshNow
methods.description: Forces an immediate recheck of permission statuses.

methods.name: startMonitoring
methods.description: Begins periodic monitoring of permission statuses using a timer.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops the periodic permission status monitoring timer.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Performs the permission status check, optionally forcing an update.
